name: Watson's Creative Store Connector
author: Watson's Creative, Inc.
release_notes: v0.3.69 subject-first RV-flag cutouts. Pairs with API v4.0.0-alpha5.2.82. The 0-100 control now applies only a narrow boundary refinement after the API selects the central subject; at 100% it trims a small fringe rather than erasing more of the photo. Pricing, cart, checkout, shipping, the Alaska business location, and the active ship-from origin are unchanged.
